path=ROOT/'ada/reuse-results.json';raw=path.read_bytes();r=json.loads(raw)
    trainedpath=ROOT/'branches/branch-3/ada/trained-results.json'
    trained=json.loads(trainedpath.read_bytes())
    runs={(x['method'],x['seed']):x for x in trained['runs']}
    pi=r['target']['probabilities'];unif=[[1/N]*N for _ in range(N)]
    uniform,_=variance(unif,pi);error=0.;residual=0.;rows=[]
    for record in r['records']:
        run=runs[(record['method'],record['seed'])];eps=record['floor']
        if record['route']=='independence':
            q=[[eps/N+(1-eps)*v for v in run['distribution']] for _ in range(N)]
        else:
            a=run['final_angles']
            rates=[(1-math.cos(a[7+k])*math.cos(a[11+k] if run['method']=='dcqaoa' else 0))/2 for k in range(4)]
            q=[[eps/N+(1-eps)*math.prod(rates[k] if (i^j)&(8>>k) else 1-rates[k] for k in range(4)) for j in range(N)] for i in range(N)]
        value,res=variance(q,pi)
        error=max(error,abs(value-record['variance']))
        residual=max(residual,res)
    assert error<1e-7 and residual<1e-9
